title: The Silent Consensus
summary: Dean Ball, Head of Strategic Futures at OpenAI, examines how more capable AI could reshape society and how people can retain control of their institutions.

title: Research acceleration: The jagged frontier
summary: OpenAI measures how coding agents are accelerating AI research, where their performance remains uneven, and what this signals about recursive self-improvement.

title: Managing frontier AI risk: From training to deployment
summary: OpenAI explains how it manages frontier AI risk from training through deployment with model alignment, sandboxing, blocking safeguards, and monitoring.

title: Le Groupe Figaro and OpenAI partner to bring Le Figaro journalism to ChatGPT
summary: Le Groupe Figaro and OpenAI partner to bring Le Figaro’s journalism to ChatGPT through summaries and excerpts, with links to original stories.

summary: OpenAI models optimized circuits used in Jalapeño silicon and improved RISC‑V core designs, showing progress in AI-assisted chip design with GPT‑6 Astra.

title: Massive New Study Shows How Young People Feel About AI Companions
summary: Gallup’s new survey studied the complex relationships people have online, in-person, and with AI.

title: [AINews] GPT-6.2 Astra, the #2 Frontier Model is better and 20%-600% cheaper, but has mixed reviews; 6.2 Sol likely main workhorse
summary: November 17, 2026 — GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol lower benchmark costs. Early testers disagree on what Astra is like to work with.

title: 黄仁勋相关传闻核查：美商务部与司法部就Megaspeed发联合声明，未认定违规芯片销售
summary: 围绕英伟达前高管黄仁勋及AI芯片转运传闻，美国商务部与司法部就Megaspeed发布联合声明，未认定存在违规芯片销售，也未将该公司列入实体清单；英伟达此前已主动切断对Megaspeed的供应。相关声明未提及间谍行为，新加坡内政部亦表示未就间谍问题调查该公司负责人。

title: Gemini 4 Neon 向 Google AI Pro 和 Ultra 订阅用户开放
summary: Google 宣布即日起 Gemini 4 Neon 向 Google AI Pro 和 Ultra 订阅用户开放，覆盖移动端、桌面端和网页端。官方称该模型擅长需要前沿级推理和快速响应的工作。

title: Google DeepMind 的 Gemini 4 Neon 上线 OpenRouter
summary: OpenRouter 宣布 Google DeepMind 的 Gemini 4 Neon 正式上线其平台，可通过 Google Cloud 使用。该模型面向复杂软件工程、知识工作和科学场景，定位介于 Carbon 与 Hydrogen 之间。Google 称其在 Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index 排名第一，每任务成本比 Carbon 低 32%。

title: 黄仁勋辞职后首次财报电话会：Nvidia 新 CEO Colette Kress 收紧支出并回应回归呼声
summary: 作者分析黄仁勋辞职后 Nvidia 首次由新 CEO Colette Kress 主持的财报电话会，指出董事会明确不打算让黄仁勋回归，也不会回答相关问题。财报释放的新条款显示 neocloud 只有在拿到融资且数据中心建成投产后才能获得 Nvidia 的采购兜底，作者认为这透露了 Nvidia 支持意愿的边界。

title: 腾讯混元宣布 11 月 20 日在 Reddit r/LocalLLaMA 举办 AMA
summary: 腾讯混元宣布本周五 11 月 20 日 8–10 AM PT 在 Reddit r/LocalLLaMA 举办 AMA，研发团队与 @ShunyuYao12 将解读刚发布的 Hy4 与 Hy4 flash。作者称 Hy4 flash 已开放权重，含 Hy4 flash-FP8 和 Hy4 flash-Base，为 224B 参数（激活 12B）、1M 上下文、原生多模态，并预告 Hy4 后续发布。

title: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4 Neon
summary: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4 Neon，主打前沿智能与快速端到端任务完成，覆盖软件工程、知识工作和科学工作流。模型在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 得 61 分排第 3，Vals Index 排第 2，Agent Arena Index 以 1336 分全球第 2。

title: 腾讯混元 Hy4 flash 开放权重，含 FP8 与 Base 版本
summary: 腾讯混元宣布 Hy4 flash 开放权重，包含 Hy4 flash-FP8 和 Hy4 flash-Base 两个版本。模型为 224B 参数（激活 12B），支持 1M 上下文，原生多模态，定位高效日常生产力场景。模型以 Tencent Hy License 发布，可在 Hugging Face（huggingface.co/tencent/Hy4-flash）和 GitHub（github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy4-flash）获取，官方预告 Hy4 即将推出。
